title: An Idea Becomes a Connected System — Frame-by-Frame Pixel Study

scenes.title: Charge and release
scenes.purpose: The idea (pixel bulb) charges on a stepped rune ring, then releases with a full-frame palette flash.
visuals: Gold rune ring growing in stepped drawings

beats.development: Idle dim bulb, then ring grows 6→19px and bulb warms in three key drawings with rising sparks.
Bulb fully lit with rays; release squash/stretch while the environment swaps to a flat flash palette.

scenes.title: Spark connects
scenes.purpose: The scene re-tints to the connected palette; a spark arcs to the core node and links draw out to satellites.
visuals: Stepped spark projectile with key-pose tail
Bresenham links revealing pixel by pixel
Satellite nodes (#72929A) appear when links arrive
Title types letter by letter between gold rules

beats.development: Spark arcs from bulb to core in five keys; core pops; title begins typing.
Title completes at 1.5s and holds; three links draw to satellites; NODES/LINKS tally climbs.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

scenes.title: System escalates and settles
scenes.purpose: Outer nodes and cross-links close the network, a surge palette and system ring escalate the effect, then the final drawing holds.
visuals: System ring outline expanding then thinning

beats.development: Cross-links and outer nodes complete the network; burst pixels and ring escalate, then thin.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

beats.development: Settled final drawing held: complete system, title and tally readable.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

findings: Drawings change on twos (12/s) and are composited at 30 fps; the final drawing holds from 2.667s so the frame is settled before 2.7s.
Title is fully legible from 1.5s to 3.0s (1.5s hold).
justifiedHolds: Final 0.333s hold lets the completed system and copy read.

notes: Recipe demonstrated: source-frame lessons from BACKGROUND_REVIEW (charge → release flash → global re-tint → effect → tally, letter-by-letter banner, dithered gradients, mirrored slice reflections) applied to a new dusk-lake palette and the idea-to-system subject.
